problem: How do I set up Claude Code hooks to run custom scripts when sessions end?
solution: Claude Code supports hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json. For SessionEnd hooks, add a configuration like: {"hooks": {"SessionEnd": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "/path/to/script.sh"}]}]}}. The script receives JSON input via stdin with fields: transcript_path (path to session JSONL), session_id, cwd, and reason (why session ended). Make sure your script is executable (chmod +x) and handles the JSON parsing (use jq for bash scripts).
